text_block_list.name: Demon Empress
text_block_list.text:
"You have done well to make it this far, 
into my magnificent realm of darkness—this 
is my welcoming chalice. 
Partake, and you shall formally become one 
of my kindred... There is no escape for 
you, mortal."

text_block_list.name: Black Knight King
text_block_list.text:
"My path of conquest exists solely for 
peace. To vanquish all of your despair. 
Even should I fall into darkness, I shall 
conquer that darkness and bring light upon 
your heads."

text_block_list.name: Demon Empress
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, my naive, darling child. 
Unleash your desires, and surrender 
yourself to the shadows."

text_block_list.name: Black Knight King
text_block_list.text:
"O, innocent subjects. 
Fear not. Entrust your fate unto my 
blade."

text_block_list.name: Demon Empress & Black Knight King
text_block_list.text: "Now————take my hand."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: [Event Title Logo]

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —One day in August.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—And so, for this year's Holy Hoof 
Festival, I was hoping to... 
participate in a major attraction that 
would draw in the visitors.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It is an important opportunity to repay 
all those who believe in, 
support, and watch over my path to 
becoming "the strongest."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
However... I am not particularly adept at 
fan service in the first place. 
I was wondering what I ought to do—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
... ...... 
Look, Duramente-san.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I hate to break it to you... but don't you 
think 
you've picked completely the wrong person 
to consult with—?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, why don't you two join 
my project?

text_block_list.name: Groove & Dura
text_block_list.text:
! Air Groove-san— 
! Big Sis Groove—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to give back to the fans is a 
noble intention. 
If you're having trouble figuring out how, 
I will guide you. Rely on me all you like.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to think I have plenty of 
experience running festival stalls. 
I promise I will provide the perfect stage 
for you to achieve your goal.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much...! That is truly 
reassuring. 
Please allow me to participate in your 
project, Big Sis Groove.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Um. 
How did I end up getting roped into this, 
too...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're already on board. Besides, every 
student is required to take part 
in some event during the Fan Appreciation 
Festival anyway.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Groove-senpai. I would be honored to have 
you... Please. 
With you there, it will be... all the more 
reassuring...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, it's settled then. 
With the three of us as core members, the 
festival booth project begins—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah. ...Pardon me, it's about time for my 
student council meeting. 
We will discuss the detailed plans later.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Now, on to the agenda regarding the Holy 
Hoof Festival. 
First, regarding the main event we 
discussed the other day—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We shall hold a "Festival Booth Contest" 
this year. 
Thank you for the proposal, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Participants who wish to enter will 
register in advance, 
and each group will be free to plan and 
run their own booth.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Visiting fans will then cast their votes 
for the booths they found most enjoyable 
or impressive... and the winner will be 
determined by the final tally.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Adding a competitive element should raise 
student morale 
and ensure that our fans have an even more 
unforgettable experience.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for approving the proposal. 
May I proceed with preparing the 
school-wide announcement at once?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course—however, before that. 
I believe we in the student council should 
do our utmost to liven up this event as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Therefore—we shall also host our very own 
booth.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's this about? 
I never heard anything about this.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha, surely you would have had that exact 
reaction whenever I brought it up? 
I promise we'll incorporate your requests 
too. What do you say, Brian?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Well, it doesn't look like Madam 
"Empress" is too keen on it either, is 
she?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that true, Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A-Ah, no! Don't phrase it weirdly, Brian! 
I am in full support of a student council 
booth. It's just—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
My apologies, but I've already committed 
to running a booth with Dura and Groove. 
I was simply contemplating whether I could 
manage both simultaneously...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oho! I see, so that's how it is. 
Hmm... In that case...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to split your focus. Give 
your full attention to your booth, Air 
Groove. 
And we, on our end, will give it 
everything we have. In the end—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—this means it is a showdown between us, 
Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Since we are participating, we intend to 
sweep the contest with blazing fervor. 
...As do you, I presume?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Without question. 
...Let us make this Holy Hoof Festival the 
grandest one yet, President.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, victory will belong to us. 
Prepare yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey... So you're really roping me into 
this in the end? 
...Hey!
